notes: Assumptions that change the number: lean mince counted as 90 % lean / 10 % fat, a 125 g raw patty each (~220 kcal); a 70 g wholewheat roll each (~190 kcal); 175 g raw sweet potato wedges each (~150 kcal); all 2 tbsp + 1 tsp oil eaten; wholegrain mustard from a label (SR Legacy has none). Published check: a lean beef burger in a wholemeal bun with sweet potato wedges is typically listed at ~550–700 kcal; 690 is at the top of that range because the recipe has both a full roll and 700 g of sweet potato for four. Trimmed 2026-10-29 to 500 g sweet potato so a serving sits under the healthy tag’s ~650 kcal (was 690).
